3. Reachable-set controllers and MPC

Compose reachability, recovery, and MPC

Ready · installed package example

The complete optimal joint family is (x0,x1,x2,u0,u1)=(0,s,1,s,1-s), 0<=s<=1. The exact-family verifier applies only to its registered profiles. Generic Strategy A/B paths are numerical candidates. Local NLP MPC makes no global optimum claim.

Mathematical input

Controller optimization problem
quantityvalue
horizon2 stages, k=0,1
terminal objectiveminimize (x₂−1)²
complete optimal familyComplete optimal histories (x₀,x₁,x₂,u₀,u₁)=(0,s,1,s,1−s), 0≤s≤1

Modules exercised by this consumer

  • csl.synthesis.strategy-b

Reproduce this result

Full input description and JSON

The discrete two-stage integrator is x1=x0+u0, x2=x1+u1 with x0=0, ui∈[0,1], and cost (x2−1)². The exact complete optimal family is (x0,x1,x2,u0,u1)=(0,s,1,s,1−s), 0≤s≤1.

Open the structured chapter manifest JSON

Command

ctest --test-dir build/dev -C Release -R "^installed_public_client$" --output-on-failure
build/dev/installed-consumer/examples-build/registered_synthesis_comparison examples/scenarios/two-stage-integrator.json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print("schema="+d["schema"]); [print(r["strategy"]+" termination="+r["termination"]+" outcome="+r["outcome"]+" witnesses="+str(len(r["witnesses"]))+" objective="+str(r["witnesses"][0]["recomputed_objective"])) for r in d["results"]]'

Expected output

schema=csl.example.synthesis-comparison/1
csl.synthesis.reach-back termination=completed outcome=optimal witnesses=2 objective=0
csl.synthesis.strategy-b termination=completed outcome=optimal witnesses=2 objective=0

Intermediate geometry. Both strategies return the two endpoint histories (u0,u1)=(0,1) and (1,0). Each history reaches x2=1 and has recomputed objective 0. The verifier marks optimality and completeness unsupported for these numerical candidates.

Support limits. This finite exact integrator comparison is distinct from nonlinear MPC and from a global optimality proof for generic Strategy A/B runs. The family payload is unavailable, so the consumer reports two witnesses only. First complete the installed-consumer setup in the opening chapter. Its CTest installs the current package and builds the isolated clients with find_package(CSL CONFIG).
